case_number: Civil Appeal No. 4545 of 2022 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) No. 13800 of 2021)
summary: Tenant failed to pay rent after lease expiry in 2014; landlord filed suit for possession, arrears, and mesne profits. Tenant claimed agreements to sell (ATS) the property and adjustment of unpaid rent against sale consideration. Trial Court upheld landlord's claim under Order XII Rule 6 CPC based on admissions in written statement; High Court affirmed. Supreme Court examined tenant's defenses, including pending specific performance suit and alleged oral agreements.
legal_provisions_cited: Shrimant Rao Suryavanshi v. Prahlad Bhairoba Suryavanshi, 2002 (3) SCC 676
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter remanded for further hearing in accordance with law.
